notes.text: The linked text describes Mar bar Pofidata of Pumbedita and his straw storehouse.
[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2427&lang=en) records the same case and says he does not know whether Mar was a sage.
